target_customer: IRL streamers and their teams and agencies streaming to Twitch, Kick and YouTube
problem: IRL streams drop when mobile networks degrade, losing viewers. Streamable runs cloud servers between streamer and platform to keep streams alive and add remote production features.
business_model: Subscription for creators and agencies (premium streaming service)

founders.name: Nang Ang
education: Carnegie Mellon University, B.S. and M.S. in Computer Engineering
founders.background_notes: YC page: top Twitch streamer in Software and Game Development category, 200k followers across social media.

founders.name: Manav Bokinala
previous_startups: AI powered app builder (name not given, outcome not stated)
founders.background_notes: YC page: infrastructure, AI and consumer experience; architected distributed systems for an AI go-to-market platform; shipped a consumer social app.

technical_complexity.rationale: Low latency cloud ingest, SRT and RTMP handling, drop protection and multistreaming are standard video infrastructure with some hard reliability work.

defensibility.rationale: A founder who is himself a streamer gives distribution, but IRLToolkit, Belabox cloud and others offer similar relays.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Streamlabs launched Network Boost for IRL creators and Kick launched a phone go live app; no acquisition of Streamable found.

market_need_then: IRL became a fast growing Twitch category (Twitch blog May 2026 and trade coverage), and dropped streams are a core pain for IRL creators.

branding.domain_note: Uses streamable.run because streamable.com belongs to the unrelated video hosting service acquired by Hopin in 2021.

identity.voice_and_tone: Casual and playful: 'Keep your IRL streams smoooooth'.

branding.brand_signature: The elongated 'smoooooth' tagline and Official Partner of Twitch Creator Program and Kick claims
branding.community_and_virality: Has X, Instagram and Discord accounts; founder is an active Twitch streamer.

brand_strength.rationale: Name collides with an older well known video host, forcing a .run domain; streamer credibility helps but no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Streamable is active with a four person team, a seed from Goodwater per the YC page, and a founder who is a top Twitch streamer. IRL streaming grew quickly in 2025 and 2026, but no revenue or later round was found, and rivals plus platform features create risk, so the outcome is undetermined.
notes: Seed from Goodwater Capital is stated on the YC page (seen via search snippet and the page); no amount or date, and no second outlet found. CB Insights results for Streamable were for the unrelated video host. Competitor searches returned only 2025 and 2026 pages (IRLToolkit, Belabox, Speedify, Moblin), none dated near the F24 batch, so list empty. YC team size 4; YC location listing differs (Los Angeles vs San Francisco in a snippet).
